title: Investment Calculator
description: Estimate how much an investment may grow, how much to contribute monthly for a target, or how long it may take to reach it.
metaDescription: Calculate investment projection, required monthly contribution, and time to goal with editable return rate, optional inflation, and shareable URL.

helpers.taxa: Use a scenario rate you enter; this calculator does not fetch current rates.
helpers.inflacao: Fill this to estimate purchasing-power value.

validation.valorInicial: Enter a starting amount from R$ 0.00 to R$ 1 billion.
validation.aporteMensal: Enter a monthly contribution from R$ 0.00 to R$ 100 million.
validation.metaValor: Enter a target above R$ 0.00 and up to R$ 10 billion.
validation.prazoMeses: Enter a whole term from 1 to 600 months.
validation.taxa: Enter a rate greater than -100% and within the selected-period limit.
validation.inflacaoAnual: Enter inflation greater than -100% and up to 1000%, or leave it blank.
validation.taxaPeriodo: Choose whether the rate is effective annual or monthly.
validation.aporteTiming: Choose whether contributions happen at the beginning or end of the month.

helpers.requiredContribution: Monthly amount solved from the future-value formula.
helpers.timeToGoal: First full month when the target is reached.
helpers.realValue: Deflated by the inflation you entered.

items.constantReturn: The simulation uses a constant return and fixed monthly contribution.
items.noTaxesFees: It does not include income tax, IOF, fund taxes, fees, custody, spreads, or operating costs.
items.noCurrentRates: The calculator does not fetch CDI, Selic, IPCA, quotes, or current market rates.
items.notAdvice: Educational result; not a recommendation of product, broker, issuer, or asset class.
items.negativeRate: A negative rate can reduce the balance and make goals hard to reach.
items.highRate: Very high rates increase the risk of unrealistic or hard-to-compare results.
items.unreachableGoal: With the assumptions entered, the target is not reached within 600 months.
items.staleSourceVersion: The link uses a missing or old formula version; safe example values were restored.

source.title: Source and scope.
source.text: Standard financial formulas for future value, payment, and number of periods; no embedded public rate table.

seo.metaDescription: Simulate investment growth with monthly contribution, target, annual or monthly rate, and optional inflation. Educational estimate only.

howItWorks.title: How the investment calculator works
howItWorks.p1: The calculator converts the rate you enter into an equivalent monthly rate and applies the future-value formula with starting amount and fixed monthly contributions.
howItWorks.p2: You can project a balance, solve the monthly contribution needed for a target, or estimate the first month when the target would be reached.

projectionVsGoal.title: Projection, required contribution, and time to goal
projectionVsGoal.p1: In projection mode, the term is fixed and the result is the estimated balance. In contribution mode, the target and term are fixed and the calculator solves the monthly amount.
projectionVsGoal.p2: In time-to-goal mode, the tool searches month by month up to 600 months. If the assumptions are not enough, it shows an unreachable-goal alert.

rates.title: Effective annual or monthly rate
rates.text: When you enter an effective annual rate, conversion uses the 12-period root. A monthly rate is applied directly each month and converted to an equivalent annual rate.

exclusions.title: What is not included
exclusions.text: The estimate does not include taxes, IOF, fees, guarantees, liquidity, mark-to-market effects, credit risk, quotes, dividends, or actual asset variation.

sources.title: Formula sources
sources.intro: The formulas were revalidated on 2026-06-26. Banco Central is an official context reference; no market rate is imported.

related.title: Related calculators

disclaimer.title: Important notice
disclaimer.text: This calculator is an educational estimate, not investment, accounting, tax, or legal advice. It does not recommend any product, broker, issuer, or asset class and does not guarantee future returns.

q1.question: Is the return rate updated automatically?
q1.answer: No. The rate is always an assumption you enter. The tool does not fetch CDI, Selic, IPCA, stocks, funds, crypto, or any quote.

q2.question: Does it include income tax, IOF, or fees?
q2.answer: No. The calculation is gross and does not include taxes, management fees, performance fees, custody, spreads, brokerage, or other costs.

q3.question: What is the difference between annual and monthly rate?
q3.answer: The effective annual rate is converted into an equivalent monthly rate. The monthly rate you enter is applied directly to each month and also converted to annual equivalent.

q4.question: Why does beginning-of-month contribution change the result?
q4.answer: Because a contribution made at the beginning of the month earns return during that month. At the end of the month, it starts earning in the next period.

q5.question: Can I use it for CDBs, Treasuries, stocks, or funds?
q5.answer: You can use it as a gross constant-return scenario, but those products have taxes, fees, risks, and behavior this calculator does not model.

q6.question: Does the result guarantee future returns?
q6.answer: No. The rate is only a hypothesis. Real results depend on markets, inflation, taxes, fees, risks, and asset behavior.
